title: The free energy of the interacting Bose gas: a variational description with loops and interlacements
summary: We consider the interacting Bose gas in the thermodynamic limit in a large box in $\R^d$ at positive temperature $1/β\in(0,\infty)$ with particle density $\simρ\in(0,\infty)$. We follow a path-integral approach and adopt from \cite {ACK10} a description of the free energy in terms of the {\it Brownian loop soup}, a Poisson point process consisting of Brownian bridges, also called loops or cycles. It is the objective of this paper to derive, for any values of $β$ and $ρ$, a formula for the limiting free energy with explicit control on the particle numbers in the short and in the long loops.…
